column1: #   Users that match no rule get the Default... values from bulkreg.ini.
#   Cluster replicas are NOT a mapping job: list your mail cluster ONCE in bulkreg.ini
#   (MailClusterServers=...). Every user whose home server is in that list automatically
#   gets a replica of the mail file on all OTHER cluster members.
# ONE RULE = ONE LINE
#   1 MatchField      Person document field to test
#                     CompanyName
#                     Find field names: open a DirSync Person document > File > Document
#                     Properties > Fields tab.
#   2 MatchPattern    Value to compare with (not case-sensitive):
#                       *@emea.demo.com  -> any value ending in @emea.demo.com
#                       Sales*           -> any value starting with Sales
#                       *london*         -> any value containing london
#                       Finance          -> exactly Finance
#                       [a-l]*           -> starts with a letter from a to l
#                     * = any text
#                     # = one digit. To match these characters literally put them in [ ]: [#]
#   3 HomeServer      Home mail server: DominoADMail2/Demo or CN=DominoADMail2/O=Demo
#                     AUTO (or empty) = the next server of the HomeServers pool in bulkreg.ini
#                     balanced so that each server gets about the same number of users
#                     HomeServerMaxUsers (2500) each.  Without a pool: DefaultHomeServer.
#   4 OrgUnit         OU in the Notes name: EMEA -> John Smith/EMEA/Demo
#                     empty = DefaultOrgUnit
#   5 Policy          EXPLICIT policy exactly as in the Policies view: */DirSync-Vault-EMEA
#                     empty = DefaultPolicy
column2: - = none (an organizational policy assigns the vault)

#   8 ClusterReplicas Servers that get a replica of the mail file
